channel.title: Irad Times
channel.description: The independent weekly of Irad since 1996.

item.title: Nobody has published who gets the revenue from Toktogul's extra 240 MW
item.description: The refit lifted the station to 1,440 MW as winter drawdown began. Kökjal families flooded out in the 1970s want compensation and a share of the new capacity, and the annex that sets the clans' share is still unpublished.

item.title: A second refinery for Kochkor-Ata was announced with no investor, no crude and no tender
item.description: Lieutenant Governor Aidar Maksat told a district meeting the government wants a 9,000-barrel-a-day plant in the Fergana rim town. Nobody has said who would build it, what it would burn or how it would be licensed.

item.title: Publish the Toktogul annex before the 2027 talks begin
item.description: The refit added 240 MW and the water is already falling. Nobody outside the room can say what the clans are paid, or whether the extra capacity changes it.

item.title: 16,500 seats, 1,200 for Tulpar: how the title decider was sold
item.description: Neftchi has given the visitors the smallest allocation the federation allows for the Kara-Ak derby on 31 October. Most of the home tickets went before public sale opened.

item.title: The $300 limit has a side door, and state contractors hold the key
item.description: A Talasbank circular seen by the Times exempts “priority payroll and import accounts” from the monthly dollar cap. Most of the 41 firms on the list do business with the state.

item.title: Sary-Bulak’s unnamed partners share an address, and a director, with a Trans-Chuy company
item.description: Two firms set up in August have applied for licences to buy antimony and supply the restart. The register puts both at 9 Terminal Road, the office of a subsidiary of the Governor’s family freight company.

item.title: Four months on, the court has time for 214 cases but not this one
item.description: The Supreme Court’s new online register lists the petition on the Governor’s inability as “awaiting listing”. The election that the answer would decide is a year away.

item.title: “Secured by Iradi water”: nobody who runs the water has been asked
item.description: Tulparcoin’s white paper rests on Toktogul. The complex, the Naryn commission and the Kökjal elders say no one has spoken to them.
